title: Guangzhou Lingwei Technology Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Materials Manufacturer
content:
Guangzhou Lingwei Technology Co., Ltd. is a listed Chinese silica-materials company with official manufacturing operations in Guangdong, Anhui, and Hunan. Public aerogel-industry source material states that the company has developed and scaled silica-aerogel production projects alongside its broader specialty silica business.

Company Overview

The official corporate site confirms Lingwei’s position as a specialty silica and advanced-materials enterprise with multiple production and research bases. In addition to the silica-centered product lines shown on the official site, public aerogel-industry reporting describes dedicated silica-aerogel projects and engineering-center activity associated with the company.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China through multiple production and R&D bases.
  • Focus Areas: Specialty silica materials, silica aerogel materials, and downstream insulation-related applications.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Silica materials and specialty functional silica products
  • Public Aerogel Project Reference: Industry-source reporting describes silica-aerogel projects in Hunan and Anhui, including historical 3,000-ton and 11,000-ton scale project references, but a single consolidated aerogel output figure is not clearly stated on the reviewed official corporate pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Presence: Guangdong, Anhui, and Hunan, China, according to public corporate and industry-source materials.
  • International Certifications: The reviewed official pages do not clearly list aerogel-specific international certification details.
  • Official Website: https://www.lingwe.com/

FAQ

Why is Guangzhou Lingwei Technology included in an aerogel directory?

The official corporate site confirms Lingwei’s specialty silica manufacturing base, while public aerogel-industry reporting describes dedicated silica-aerogel project investment and engineering-center activity linked to the company.

What is Lingwei mainly known for?

Lingwei is mainly known for specialty silica and related advanced-materials products, with aerogel development described in public industry-source reporting.

Is the aerogel capacity figure fully confirmed on the official site?

No. The reviewed official site confirms the broader company and manufacturing footprint, while the specific aerogel project scale comes from public industry-source reporting.
